item.title: Work around a water shutoff
item.context_text: Your building will have a planned water shutoff. Your housemate works nights and has not seen the notice.
item.objective_text: Explain the change and negotiate access to the flat for a separate repair.
item.target_grammar: From and until for a time range. Could you and would it be possible for requests.
success_conditions: Explain the change and negotiate access to the flat for a separate repair.
Say to fill something before the shutoff
Confirm a resident will be home

children.title: Check the details
children.instructions: Read the message and use its details to answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
BUILDING NOTICE
Water will be off from 1 pm to 4 pm on Tuesday while a main valve is replaced. Fill any containers before 1 pm. Pressure may be low for half an hour after service returns. The caretaker can check a separate leak in flat 14 only with a resident present. Available appointments: Tuesday 2 pm or Wednesday 9 am.

questions.prompt: Why might the shower still run slowly at 4:15 pm on Tuesday?
options: The flat's leak checks finish at 4:15.
The water shutoff actually starts at 4 pm.
Pressure may stay low for a short time after 4 pm.
questions.explanation: The notice allows another half-hour of low pressure after the scheduled restoration at 4 pm.

questions.prompt: What is required for the check in flat 14?
options: A resident needs to be there.
The main valve must still be off.
The caretaker needs a written leak report.
questions.explanation: The notice explicitly requires a resident to be present for access.

children.title: Warn your housemate
children.instructions: Tell your housemate the shutoff hours and suggest a practical step for before the work.
children.prompt_text: Housemate: Will there be water when I get home on Tuesday?
children.goal: Give the window and suggest preparing water in advance.

points.label: Say to fill something before the shutoff

children.model_answer: It will be off from 1 pm until 4 pm on Tuesday. Can you fill a bottle before 1? The pressure may still be low for a little while after four.

children.title: Book the leak check
children.instructions: You cannot be home on Tuesday. Request Wednesday at 9 and confirm that you can give the caretaker access.
children.prompt_text: Caretaker: Which appointment would suit you?
children.goal: Make an appointment and confirm access.

points.label: Confirm a resident will be home

children.model_answer: Could we do Wednesday at nine, please? I'll be home to let you in and show you where the leak is.
